The '''Boneyard''' was a small valley located on the western edge of the [[Nightmare Lands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. Named for the massive skeletons of long-dead beasts in the area, the Boneyard was controlled by the [[Thalak]] tribe of [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]], who had battled the [[Galactic Republic]] in the area and destroyed at least one [[Manka-class armored transport|''Manka''-class armored transport]]. The western cliff was the site of a tunnel leading to [[Desolation Pass]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Boneyard appears as a Heroic area on Voss in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
